description: Details of a demolition method statement and construction management plan pursuant to condition 5 of planning permission ref: 244597HH dated 14/02/2025 for: Excavation to provide basement level beneath the existing house and garden with lightwell; two storey rear extension; creation of a rear roof terrace at second floor level of existing flat roof; roof alteration involving raising of the ridge height, installation of one conservation style roof light to front roof slope, three conservation roof lights to side (western) roof slope and installation of four conservation style rooflight to side (eastern) roof slope; installation of frosted glass bricks to side (eastern) elevation; replacement of existing windows; and boundary treatment
